MONOPOLY Casino Welcome Offer FAQs

How do I claim my welcome offer?
Join as a new member and select your preferred welcome offer - casino free spins or sports free bets - before making your first deposit. Your offer is credited once you’ve opted in, deposited and completed the qualifying requirements.
Do I have to use my free spins or free bets all at once?
No. Free spins and free bet tokens don't all need to be used in one go. However, both carry a 30-day expiry from the point they're credited, and any unused spins or tokens will be removed from your account after that window closes.
Does the casino welcome bonus have any wagering requirements on winnings?
No. Any winnings from your 30 free spins are credited to your account balance and withdrawable as cash.
